title: Beamer Pricing: Plans, Add-Ons and Total Cost (2026)
summary: Beamer pricing puts different limits on each tier—segmentation, languages, user seats, branding—so you can match features to your requirements.
body_markdown:
## Hidden costs and limits Beamer users run into


Look past those two $99 add-ons, which are only the visible extras. Extra audience packs, monthly billing, branding removal and staff time all sit outside the headline number, so the **real bill runs higher than the plan card** .


### Features gated by tier


Grow your audience and the bill rises even if you never change plan, because extra monthly-active-user packs cost $50 a month per 5,000.


Compare the steps, though: the API allowances rise much faster than the prices do. According to the[Beamer API docs](https://getbeamer-api.pages.dev/) , **Free gets 1000 requests a month** and Starter 2000.


That's roughly 33 calls a day on Free, so a nightly sync script can exhaust it. Pro gets 20000 and Scale 100000, which means any integration-heavy setup is really a Pro or Scale purchase, whatever the feature list suggests.


When Beamer's built-in channels fall short and an announcement has to reach Slack, email or a CRM, Activepieces can carry it there, and it meters the run, not the steps inside it: 1 credit per flow run on its pricing page, so a ten-step flow that posts to Slack, emails a list and updates a CRM record costs the same as a two-step workaround.


Zapier's pricing page bills per task and Make's per module, which taxes you for splitting work into smaller, more reliable steps. The free plan gives you 1,000 credits a month with unlimited flows, and MoneyGram, Moneypenny, Alan and FundingSocieties run Activepieces in production.


Before you assume a clean widget comes with the plan, confirm which tier carries branding removal, because it also sits on a higher tier.


### Beamer billing, annual versus monthly pricing


According to[Produktly's Beamer breakdown](https://produktly.com/pricing/beamer) , Starter is listed at 49 – 59 $ per month and Scale at 249 – 299 $ per month. The lower figure is the annual rate and the higher the monthly one.


That's a premium of about $10 on Starter and $50 on Scale, roughly 20% either way.


If you choose monthly billing for flexibility, you pay about two and a half months' fees extra across a year. Annual billing removes that premium but commits you before you know whether the gated feature works for your team.


### Work the price doesn't cover


No tier covers the hours spent writing changelog entries, maintaining segments, translating posts or answering the first round of feedback.


At $49 a month, a tool that needs a few hours of someone's week isn't a $49 tool once you include the labor component. Count those hours at your own internal rate before you compare plans.
